prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: one original image-only editorial campaign illustration, landscape 3:2, preferably 1536x1024.
Primary request: A minimal sculptural VIOLET WINDING PATH connects four tactile objects across a small olive and blush-pink landscape: an open BLANK ivory book with thick softly curved unprinted pages, a small naturally irregular ivory wool cloud, a pale fabric windsock on a slim ivory pole, and a tiny layered terrain model showing stacked felt/clay contour strata. The path is continuous and softly raised like a matte violet ceramic/felt ribbon, meandering elegantly from one object to the next. These four elements form one quiet wayfinding metaphor, not an app interface. The terrain model is a small distinct model resting on the larger landscape.
View: low oblique viewpoint with visible miniature horizon and tangible depth. Make the open book, cloud, windsock and layered miniature all separately legible. Fresh composition, deliberately different from a dramatic weather section and from overhead experiment trays.
Style: refined mature editorial romance, polished real miniature diorama photography; tactile felt and wool fibers, matte clay and gently fibrous paper, realistic studio lighting with warm ivory sunlight and nuanced soft contact shadows. No childish toy aesthetic or decorative icon repetition. Previously inspected wind-v1.webp and sounding-v1.webp are only texture/lighting references, not compositions to repeat.
Palette: violet #743cdd path; muted olive #706936 rolling ground; blush pink #ffe2ec ground accents and backdrop; warm ivory #fff7ed book, cloud and windsock.
Composition: a single continuous physical sculptural scene, wide generous framing and breathing room. All four important objects and the entire connecting path in the central 76 percent image width and central 72 percent image height, allowing centered 16:9 crop without clipping book, windsock pole or terrain. No oversized foreground objects. Low oblique angle, restrained clear visual hierarchy.
Absolutely NO writing anywhere on book or objects, no text, numbers, letters, logos, watermarks, people, faces, symbols, map labels, arrows, pins, UI, product screenshots, factual cloud photographs, or slide copy. No extra objects. One individual illustration, no contact sheet.

visual_inspection.notes: Continuous violet tactile path connects a blank open ivory book, small wool cloud, pale windsock and layered contour terrain model. Low oblique viewpoint, olive felt landscape and rose sky. Important objects fully visible; centered 16:9 crop preserves them.
